sql: with last_tick as (select distinct on (t.live_order_id) t.live_order_id, t.features_json f from live_order_queue_ticks t join live_orders lo on lo.id=t.live_order_id where lo.strategy='Fmmsell10' and lo.status in ('filled','canceled') and lo.created_at > timestamptz '2026-09-16 11:00:00+00' order by t.live_order_id, t.captured_at desc), j as (select lo.status, (lt.f->>'volume_since_placement')::float vol, (lt.f->>'trades_since_placement')::int trades, (lt.f->>'qty_at_our_price')::float qty_our, (lt.f->>'qty_better')::float qty_better from last_tick lt join live_orders lo on lo.id=lt.live_order_id) select 'vol_since_placement '||case when vol is null then 'z_null' when vol=0 then 'a_0' when vol<=5 then 'b_1-5' when vol<=20 then 'c_6-20' else 'd_20plus' end lbl, count(*)::text n, round(100.0*count(*) filter (where status='filled')/count(*))::text fill_pct from j group by 1 union all select 'qty_at_our_price '||case when qty_our is null then 'z_null' when qty_our=0 then 'a_0' when qty_our<=10 then 'b_1-10' when qty_our<=100 then 'c_11-100' else 'd_100plus' end, count(*)::text, round(100.0*count(*) filter (where status='filled')/count(*))::text from j group by 1 union all select 'qty_better '||case when qty_better is null then 'z_null' when qty_better=0 then 'a_0' when qty_better<=10 then 'b_1-10' else 'c_10plus' end, count(*)::text, round(100.0*count(*) filter (where status='filled')/count(*))::text from j group by 1 order by 1
